title: Which substrates a law fails on, and whether globally
claim: Which substrates a law fails on, and whether globally. On a connected cubic substrate (a 3-regular 3-uniform system), with signs: (1) the knot (not-all-equal) fails under some signing exactly when the substrate is Pfaffian, and every failure is global: removing any line leaves it colourable (Seymour's bound); (2) parity fails exactly when the substrate has an even number of perfect matchings (det = perm mod 2), and no failure is ever global, since a dependency using every line would put each point in three of them, an odd number; blurred parity fails exactly as parity does; (3) Z3-linear x + y + z = c fails on every substrate, because the sum of all lines vanishes (3 = 0 mod 3), and its failures are all global when the substrate's Z3-corank is 1 and all local otherwise; blurred Z3 fails exactly as Z3 does. Checked on all 60 connected cubic substrates with up to 8 points: Pfaffian by a signing with |det| = perm (agreeing with the census), the knot's failures minimal, parity's never, Z3's minimal exactly at corank 1. (4) So blurred Z3 on corank-1 substrates both selects and composes: its failures are global and recognisable, removing a line leaves exactly three solutions so its count is easy there (checked against brute force), its count is #P-complete in general, and it composes like cycles: the first law that does both, at four values. Its selection is linear (the whole space cancels, 3 = 0 mod 3); the knot's is sign-nonsingular (nothing cancels). (5) Rigidity: on blurred Z3's selected spaces, removing a line leaves one degree of freedom, so every circuit is a tie of two variables and no knot survives (every corank-1 substrate, every line); the knot's selected spaces are not rigid in general (on the Fano plane every line removal leaves 10 colourings and a knot), though on some Pfaffian substrates only ties remain. The four-value bridge selects only rigid, pairwise spaces.
failure_conditions: A connected cubic substrate where the knot fails non-globally, or fails without being Pfaffian.
A substrate where signed parity fails globally, or fails with an odd number of perfect matchings.
A substrate where signed Z3 fails locally at corank 1 or globally at corank 2 or more.
A corank-1 failing Z3 system with a line whose removal leaves other than three solutions.
A corank-1 failing Z3 system minus a line with a circuit of three or more variables.
foundation_claim_scope: Failures of three laws on connected cubic substrates; the bridge is stated for blurred Z3 on corank-1 substrates.

validation.status: checked: all 60 connected cubic bipartite substrates with up to 8 points; Pfaffian signings, minimality of the knot's failures, parity's and Z3's failures over every right-hand side or a sample, blurred Z3 counts against brute force; no human or external review
